"shall not be liable to Vendor for any liquidated damages or penalty"

elements.element: Removal of the 15%-of-annual-Fees-per-week liquidated damages charge

reasons: The locked preferred level is fully achieved: the operative sentence flips the Customer-payable liquidated damages/penalty into an express prohibition, eliminating the 15%-per-week charge.
Change is confined to the single offending sentence via one replace operation; the payment-default trigger, Vendor's other remedies, and the Section 7.3 interest treatment are untouched.

Retaining the 15% figure only as an 'including' illustration of what is not payable adds no obligation and does not create an undefined term or dangling mechanic, so minimality and intent are preserved.

Fallback is not satisfied on its own terms (no early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees), but that is irrelevant because the stronger preferred position is met and the two levels must not be blended.
